Section 2. Safety Standards
Safety is the reason Wag & Whisker exists, so we hold every product to the same rules before
it reaches our catalogue.
Materials policy
We build our toys from a short list of materials: natural rubber, food-grade silicone, organic
cotton and felted wool, plus untreated natural woods and grasses for our small-pet range. We
do not use BPA, phthalates or latex fillers in any product. Dyes, where we use them, are
water-based and colour-fast. If a material isn't on our approved list, it doesn't go into a Wag
& Whisker toy.
Independent testing
Every design is independently tested to ASTM F963 before it goes on sale. Testing covers
small parts, sharp edges, seam strength and the materials themselves. When we change a
design, even slightly, it is tested again.
Chew ratings explained
Every dog toy carries a chew rating from 1 to 4 so you can match the toy to how your dog
plays:
• 1 Gentle: for licking, carrying and soft mouthing. Ideal for older dogs, gentle players
and enrichment toys.
